ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture shows a regular hexagonal sheet of paper, with point O marked at the center. The hexagon has three corners marked with black dots, respectively at the upper-left corner, the rightmost corner, and the lower-left corner; among the vertices of the hexagon, these three corners appear with one vertex between each pair, that is, they are three alternating vertices. Then reason: Number the vertices of the regular hexagon in order, and these three marked corners can be regarded as three alternating vertices 120° apart. The problem says to fold all three of these marked corners to the center O of the hexagon. Each time a corner is folded to O, the crease is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment connecting that corner and O. Since the three lines from the corners to the center are 120° apart in a regular hexagon, the corresponding three creases also enclose a triangular boundary. After the paper at the three corners is folded inward, the outer contour becomes this triangle. Therefore the resulting figure is a triangle.

method.method_draft: Label the regular hexagon’s vertices in order and note from the image that the marked corners are three alternate vertices: upper-left, rightmost, and lower-left, with the center O shown. From the text, each of these three marked corners is folded to the center. For each corner-to-center fold, the crease must be the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining that corner to O. In a regular hexagon, the three alternate corner-to-center segments are equally spaced by 120 degrees, so their perpendicular bisector creases form the three sides of a central triangular boundary. After all three corner flaps are folded inward, the outer visible outline is therefore a triangle.

先描述图像：图中是一张正六边形纸片，中心位置标有点 O。六边形有三个黑点标记的角，分别在左上角、最右角和左下角；这三个角在六边形顶点中是相隔一个顶点出现的，即三个交替顶点。

再推理：按顺序给正六边形顶点编号，可把这三个 marked corners 看作三个相隔 120° 的交替顶点。题目说把这三个 marked corners 都折到六边形中心 O。每次把一个角折到 O 时，折痕是该角与 O 连线的垂直平分线。由于这三条角到中心的连线在正六边形中相隔 120°，对应的三条折痕也围成一个三角形边界。三个角的纸片向内折后，外轮廓就变成这个三角形。因此得到的图形是三角形。
